about: The apps the Windows test installs and starts through Obstat's own code (lib/apps.js and lib/worker.js), then opens in Obstat's viewer. Their commits and scripts come from picks.json (see sync-picks.mjs). Apps left out are listed under notTested with the reason.

buildui.about: A command-line app with no screen: the qr command. Installed with the install step Obstat writes for Python repos, then given a screen with Build a UI.

notTested.divinadevosai/socialcleanup: a browser extension: its start step opens Edge's extensions page on purpose, there is no page to show in Obstat
notTested.pinokiofactory/z-image-turbo: needs an NVIDIA graphics card (20 GB model)
notTested.pinokiofactory/flux-webui: needs an NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB or more
notTested.pinokiofactory/cogvideo: needs an NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB or more
notTested.pinokiofactory/clarity-refiners-ui: loads several GB of image models when it starts; too heavy for a free runner
notTested.pinokiofactory/Allegro-txt2vid-install: needs an NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB or more
notTested.pinokiofactory/audiocraft_plus: needs an NVIDIA graphics card (imports xformers, which only the NVIDIA install has)
notTested.pinokiofactory/MMAudio: loads several GB of models when it starts; very slow without an NVIDIA graphics card
notTested.pinokiofactory/whisper-webui: on Windows it needs an NVIDIA graphics card: without one its own steps install torch 2.7.0 but leave a newer torchaudio, which can't load
